pages.title: Femto Fabricator
pages.text: Builds components smaller than a proton - and assembles them into processors.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Scale check: a femtometre is 10^-15 m, about the width of a proton. Ordinary chips are measured in nanometres, a million times larger. Anything built here has more in common with a nucleus than with a circuit.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (6 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Adaptive Feedback Core, Attoscale Capacitor, Attoscale Inductor, Attoscale Transistor, Femtoscale Capacitor, Femtoscale Inductor, Femtoscale Transistor, Pixel Tracker Module, Plasma Nozzle Tip, Quantum Processor, Topological Processor.
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Femto Fabricator$(): Femtoscale Assembly Line
